column1: # 虚拟手柄首次用 3D 布局（十字键、右摇杆、L3 / R3）：右摇杆转视角 | the virtual gamepad starts in the 3D layout (D-pad, right stick, L3 / R3): the right stick turns the camera
# Layout captures (CaptureOn panes, about 140 layouts) keep their blurred alpha in the red channel of an R8 render target mapped R 0 0 1; every pixel-shader variant of the layout library
# (main's BNSH at 0x1d83000) reads such textures with alpha = red: soft prompt shadows and glows instead of hard-edged boxes and cloud-filled rectangles
# Scene captures: the game copies the frame through a view mapped R G B 0. Copied into RGB10A2 targets (menu background, weapon wheel slots) the blurred picture is drawn blended by
# that alpha and must read 1, otherwise the menus sit on black and the slots are white; copied into RGBA8 targets (HUD text glows, the noise meter) the 0 is the mask and stays
# 只解了合并 1.9.0 的那份；基础版单独的构建号用到时再补 | only the merged 1.9.0 copy is extracted; the base game's own build IDs are added when needed
# NPDM 不声明系统资源（META +0x14 = 0）：走 SetHeapSize。先用十三机兵防卫圈的分区（块 4 GB = 前置 256 MB + 别名区 256 MB + 栈区 256 MB + 堆区 3.25 GB），实测后再定

# The NPDM declares no system resource (META +0x14 = 0): the game uses SetHeapSize. Starts from 13 Sentinels' partition (4 GB block = 256 MB in front + 256 MB alias region + 256 MB stack region + 3.25 GB heap region) until measured
